observations.what: Function returns early for empty graph, singleton graph, disconnected graph, and graph exceeding max_nodes. Spectral computation only occurs for connected graphs with 2 or more nodes.
Eigenvalues list for disconnected graphs is truncated to at most 8 entries, which may not match the number of connected components.
Sparse eigensolver (eigsh) is used for graphs with >8 nodes; fallback returns _empty on failure.
The function assumes numpy and scipy are available when HAVE_MATH is true; no error handling for missing imports beyond the initial check.
